verdict.rationale: CDP Payments documents deposit destinations: stable onchain addresses that customers or external parties send funds to, with the corresponding account's balance credited automatically. Webhooks can notify on that activity, so incoming funds can be attributed by address rather than matched by hand. Missing for 10: explicit per-customer address provisioning or customer metadata/labels on deposit destinations, named fiat virtual accounts, a documented reconciliation/attribution field in deposit events, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
